title: Craftable Mob Eggs
description: With this project you can simply craft mob eggs. Perfect for survival worlds!
body:
# Craftable Mob Eggs

ADDED 10/75

## **Informations**

### About

This datapack adds crafting recipe for every mob in minecraft (10 for now but I will make all) This datapack is perfect for a tired survival or hardcore players that needs some help with transporting mobs.

### Compability

This datapack is for 1.21 but i will try to make it 1.13 - 1.21.5

### Recipe

Every recipe are in the datapack just click download with recipe, click to the zip find folder named "<version> Recipe" to see all the named mobs.

### Suggestions

I will maybe add Craftable Spawners to make very effiecient farms but of course it will be balanced ;).

### Other

I added 75 Mobs to datapack but I need some time to make it for you.
